# Thunderbird Calendar create/edit attribute-driven source loader

D321284’s serializable Redux draft/session model keeps raw calendar objects outside Redux. `Slice.mjs` filenames activate state-management rules; update imports and sorted `moz.build` entries together. `updateSection` needs a complete section patch: an omitted changed property can falsely clear `dirtySections`; the focused dirty-state test keeps the section dirty until both start and end return to baseline. [Task 15]

Scope: calendar.
